<?php
/**
 * Message Queue Consumer for Kubernetes deployment
 * Processes encrypted task payloads from RabbitMQ
 * 
 * Environment: PHP 8.2, ext-openssl, php-amqplib
 * K8s: Deployed as a StatefulSet with persistent volume for key storage
 */

namespace App\Consumer;

use PhpAmqpLib\Connection\AMQPStreamConnection;
use PhpAmqpLib\Message\AMQPMessage;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

class TaskConsumer
{
    private string $encryptionKey;
    private string $hmacKey;
    private LoggerInterface $logger;
    private AMQPStreamConnection $connection;
    private const CIPHER = 'aes-256-cbc';
    private const HMAC_ALGO = 'sha256';
    private const IV_LENGTH = 16;
    private const HMAC_LENGTH = 32;

    public function __construct(LoggerInterface $logger)
    {
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->encryptionKey = $this->loadKey('/etc/secrets/encryption-key');
        $this->hmacKey = $this->loadKey('/etc/secrets/hmac-key');
        $this->connection = new AMQPStreamConnection(
            getenv('RABBITMQ_HOST') ?: 'rabbitmq-service',
            (int)(getenv('RABBITMQ_PORT') ?: 5672),
            getenv('RABBITMQ_USER') ?: 'consumer',
            getenv('RABBITMQ_PASS') ?: ''
        );
    }

    private function loadKey(string $path): string
    {
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Key file not found: $path");
        }
        $key = file_get_contents($path);
        if ($key === false || strlen($key) < 32) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Invalid key at: $path");
        }
        return substr($key, 0, 32);
    }

    public function consume(string $queueName = 'task_queue'): void
    {
        $channel = $this->connection->channel();
        $channel->queue_declare($queueName, false, true, false, false);
        $channel->basic_qos(null, 1, null);

        $callback = function (AMQPMessage $msg) {
            $this->processMessage($msg);
        };

        $channel->basic_consume($queueName, '', false, false, false, false, $callback);

        $this->logger->info('Consumer started, waiting for messages...');
        while ($channel->is_consuming()) {
            $channel->wait();
        }
    }

    private function processMessage(AMQPMessage $msg): void
    {
        $startTime = microtime(true);
        $correlationId = $msg->get('correlation_id') ?? 'unknown';
        
        try {
            $payload = $this->decryptPayload($msg->getBody());
            if ($payload === null) {
                $this->rejectMessage($msg, $correlationId, 'Decryption failed');
                return;
            }

            $task = json_decode($payload, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $this->executeTask($task);
            $msg->ack();
            $this->logger->info("Task completed", [
                'correlation_id' => $correlationId,
                'duration_ms' => (microtime(true) - $startTime) * 1000
            ]);
        } catch (\JsonException $e) {
            $this->rejectMessage($msg, $correlationId, 'Invalid JSON payload');
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->logger->error("Task processing failed", [
                'correlation_id' => $correlationId,
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ]);
            $msg->nack(false, true); // requeue
        }
    }

    private function decryptPayload(string $raw): ?string
    {
        $decoded = base64_decode($raw, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            $this->logger->warning('Base64 decode failed');
            return null;
        }

        $minLength = self::HMAC_LENGTH + self::IV_LENGTH + 16; // at least one block
        if (strlen($decoded) < $minLength) {
            $this->logger->warning('Payload too short');
            return null;
        }

        // Extract components: HMAC(32) || IV(16) || Ciphertext
        $hmac = substr($decoded, 0, self::HMAC_LENGTH);
        $iv = substr($decoded, self::HMAC_LENGTH, self::IV_LENGTH);
        $ciphertext = substr($decoded, self::HMAC_LENGTH + self::IV_LENGTH);

        // Verify HMAC over IV + ciphertext
        $computedHmac = hash_hmac(self::HMAC_ALGO, $iv . $ciphertext, $this->hmacKey, true);
        
        if (!hash_equals($computedHmac, $hmac)) {
            $this->logger->warning('HMAC verification failed');
            return null;
        }

        // Decrypt
        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt(
            $ciphertext,
            self::CIPHER,
            $this->encryptionKey,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv
        );

        if ($plaintext === false) {
            $this->logger->warning('Decryption failed - invalid padding or corrupted data');
            return null;
        }

        return $plaintext;
    }

    private function rejectMessage(AMQPMessage $msg, string $correlationId, string $reason): void
    {
        $this->logger->warning("Message rejected", [
            'correlation_id' => $correlationId,
            'reason' => $reason
        ]);
        
        // Send error response if reply_to is set
        if ($msg->has('reply_to')) {
            $channel = $msg->getChannel();
            $responsePayload = json_encode([
                'status' => 'error',
                'reason' => $reason,
                'correlation_id' => $correlationId
            ]);
            $response = new AMQPMessage($responsePayload, [
                'correlation_id' => $correlationId,
                'content_type' => 'application/json'
            ]);
            $channel->basic_publish($response, '', $msg->get('reply_to'));
        }
        
        $msg->nack(false, false); // reject without requeue
    }

    private function executeTask(array $task): void
    {
        $type = $task['type'] ?? 'unknown';
        $data = $task['data'] ?? [];

        match ($type) {
            'email' => $this->sendEmail($data),
            'report' => $this->generateReport($data),
            'cleanup' => $this->performCleanup($data),
            default => throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Unknown task type: $type")
        };
    }

    private function sendEmail(array $data): void
    {
        // Email sending implementation
        $this->logger->info('Email task processed', ['to' => $data['to'] ?? 'unknown']);
    }

    private function generateReport(array $data): void
    {
        // Report generation implementation
        $this->logger->info('Report generated', ['report_id' => $data['id'] ?? 'unknown']);
    }

    private function performCleanup(array $data): void
    {
        // Cleanup implementation
        $this->logger->info('Cleanup performed', ['target' => $data['target'] ?? 'unknown']);
    }

    public function __destruct()
    {
        try {
            $this->connection->close();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            // Ignore close errors during shutdown
        }
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$logger = new class implements LoggerInterface {
    public function emergency(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('EMERGENCY', $message, $context); }
    public function alert(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('ALERT', $message, $context); }
    public function critical(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('CRITICAL', $message, $context); }
    public function error(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('ERROR', $message, $context); }
    public function warning(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('WARNING', $message, $context); }
    public function info(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('INFO', $message, $context); }
    public function debug(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('DEBUG', $message, $context); }
    public function notice(string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void { $this->log('NOTICE', $message, $context); }
    public function log($level, string|\Stringable $message, array $context = []): void {
        $timestamp = date('c');
        $contextStr = $context ? ' ' . json_encode($context) : '';
        fwrite(STDERR, "[$timestamp] [$level] $message$contextStr\n");
    }
};

$consumer = new TaskConsumer($logger);
$consumer->consume();
